def_en: 1) between, among, in the midst of (with other preps), from between
kjv: among, asunder, at, between (-twixt...and), [phrase] from (the widest), [idiom] in, out of, whether (it be...or), within.
expl: between (repeated before each noun, often with other particles); also as a conjunction, either...or
etim: (sometimes in the plural masculine or feminine); properly, the constructive form of an otherwise unused noun from ; a distinction; but used only as a preposition,
